Read left column then right column, with page738 four narrative blocks surrounding its separately classified chapter heading. All running titles, folios and printer signatures classified; all indented continuations grouped, preserving exact raw glyphs, IDs and bboxes. No fixed row assumption. Primary Kyrgyz/Russian Yudakhin dictionary and Kyrgyz editorial glossaries used only as lexical aids. No previous English poem translation used.
transcription_check.pair_review: All 1536 reconstructed Kyrgyz-English pairs read in source order: seven blocks of200 and final136. Initial lexical revisions included in full review; all28 subsequent revised/held pairs separately reread against exact Kyrgyz. 18 whole unresolved verses excluded with complete source fragments and reasons. Every repetition retained. Narrative covers Kardygach on lookout, Bakai finding Shuutu, denunciation of the forty warriors and six uncles, Shuutu diverting warriors, ruined Talas and inheritance, Abyke greeting Semetey and Kobosh occupying the throne. Speaker allegations, miraculous and hostile claims, numbers and source inconsistencies preserved. No expert certification.
